positions.title: Technician (Apple via Apex)
positions.description:
● Used Python to automate Geographic processes.
● Troubleshot internal web applications.

positions.title: Support Analyst Intern
positions.description:
● Assisted users and Support Analysts with various incidents with topics that included  ArcGIS for Desktop, Python, modelbuilder, ArcGIS for Server, geoprocessing, geodatabases and much more.
● Worked on a group project with three of my colleagues in which we utilized GeoEvent Process for Server to record and analyze spatially aware tweets from the 2014 Fifa world Cup semi-Final Games.
●Developed a story map showing the location and some facts about all the Esri Interns in the Esri Technical support program for 2014.
●Began the development and integration of a "Points of Interest" web application that used the ArcGIS geoform and shortlist source code.
● Exposed to the broad spectrum of ArcGIS technologies and what they are readily used for throughout several industries.
